metric_definitions.cost_per_verified_success: Positive tasks only: total model cost in USD, including failed attempts, divided by rechecked passes. Null if any cost or outcome is unknown, or there are no passes.
metric_definitions.operator_interventions: Recorded operator intervention counts across all attempts in the group; missing values remain unknown.
metric_definitions.paired_deltas: Changed geometry minus normal geometry for the matched input, including failed attempts. Null if either measurement is unknown.
